answered.sql: SELECT A.name, BT.type FROM Architects A JOIN Architects_Building_Types ABT ON A.id = ABT.architect_id JOIN Building_Types BT ON ABT.building_type_id = BT.id

candidates.meaning: Identify the specific building types each architect has worked on.

candidates.meaning: Determine the building types that each architect is known for.
candidates.sql: SELECT A.name, GROUP_CONCAT(BT.type) AS building_types FROM Architects A JOIN Architects_Building_Types ABT ON A.id = ABT.architect_id JOIN Building_Types BT ON ABT.building_type_id = BT.id GROUP BY A.name
